basic_info.description:
Unique, beautiful and cozy, light-filled 2 bed/2 bath condo in Lower Pacific Heights. Tree-filled outlooks from every room and a private balcony off of the dining room. 

 Absent from the tour is an oversized pantry.

Fillmore shops and restaurants right outside the common courtyard area. Building has an elevator, garage is attached and in the first floor of the building. Walk Score of 99. Walk to UCSF Mt. Zion, Alta Plaza Park with sweeping views of the city, Japantown, or the Raymond Kimball Park Playground two blocks away.

New remodeled kitchen with custom cabinetry, walk-in pantry, and newer appliances. The living room features a marble fireplace and a brick feature wall. Pre-wired for home theatre audio and video with updated dimmable recessed lighting throughout the home. In-home washer and dryer. An abundance of storage with Elfa closet systems in the walk-in closets and even a dedicated private storage room adjacent to the home (not pictured). 

An oversized 1-car garage parking spot is included with the rent in the building's spacious attached garage.

Security deposit $4495. $39 application fee per resident.
